inlet_protocol_scope: Future-only MAC inlet face flux parcels; each packet volume is apportioned by face-normal flux and transverse births lie on MAC face centres. Births are injected after the interval pressure/MAC solve and RT0-advected only for the exact remaining characteristic time; no past state or mass changes
transport_scope: RT0 exact frozen-grid characteristics wholly inside real mass-supported pressure domain; no air extension or artificial mass. APIC momentum unchanged; accumulated logJ never corrects old density
particle_boundary: RT0 shared zero-flux voxel faces; exact outlet-plane TOI ends material tracking and explicit sink removes exited mass/energy; no finite position projection or momentum impulse

forming.boundary_scope: Union of actual F-advected quadrature cells evaluated at cell centres; staircase fixed boundary, grid-scale geometry error, not smooth surface/FSI/cure

pressure: mass-metric mixed JAX LSQR; original threshold plus complete positive-face owned/reachable domain closure; true primal residual<=1e-7, stationarity<=1e-10; pressure reconstruction diagnosed separately
physical_scope: Fixed actual fibre obstacles; laminar Newtonian filling, no cure, no full FSI, no prescribed final resin geometry
